name: Curiosity Rover (Mars Science Laboratory)
summary: Curiosity is a car-sized nuclear-powered rover exploring the geology of Gale Crater.
hook: I have climbed Mount Sharp inside Gale Crater since 2012 investigating past habitable environments.
how_it_worked: Landed via sky-crane rocket system and runs on an RTG nuclear generator with laser spectrometers and sample drills.
science: Discovered ancient organic molecules and evidence that fresh lake water once persisted in Gale Crater.

facts.text: Curiosity has driven over 30 kilometers across Gale Crater and continues active science operations.
Uses its ChemCam instrument to vaporize rock samples with laser pulses from up to 7 meters away.

image.alt: Curiosity rover self-portrait taken with its arm camera at Rocknest in Gale Crater
